label: SRv6 Segment Routing Header
notes: SRv6 Segment Routing Header (SRH), Routing Type 4 of the IPv6 Routing extension header (next header 43), the data plane of Segment Routing over IPv6 (RFC 8754). Only the fixed 8-byte header is modelled: everything after byte 8 is the Segment List, a variable count of 128-bit IPv6 addresses (four times the 4-byte BPF load window), followed by optional variable-length TLVs (RFC 8754 section 2.1), so no byte past the header sits at a trustworthy fixed offset. The locator pins Routing Type 4, the ikev2 pattern, so deprecated Type 0 and RPL routing headers do not match. The Flags byte carries no defined bits in RFC 8754 (section 8.1 only creates the IANA registry); the Protected/OAM/Alert/HMAC bits of the earlier spring-srh drafts did not survive to the final RFC. The active segment travels in the IPv6 destination address and the list is stored last-segment-first: Segment List[0] is the final segment of the policy.

fields.label: Next Header
fields.description: Type of the header immediately following the SRH.

fields.label: Hdr Ext Len
fields.description: SRH length in 8-octet units, not counting the first 8 octets; a 3-segment SRH without TLVs carries 6.

fields.label: Routing Type
fields.description: Routing header type from the IANA Routing Types registry; 4 identifies the SRH.

fields.label: Segments Left
fields.description: Number of route segments remaining; the index into the Segment List of the active segment, decremented at each SR segment endpoint node.

fields.label: Last Entry
fields.description: Zero-based index of the last element of the Segment List; with a reduced SRH (RFC 8754 section 4.1.1) the first segment is omitted.

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Eight flag bits, none defined by RFC 8754 (the registry of section 8.1 is empty); MUST be 0 on transmission and ignored on receipt.

fields.label: Tag
fields.description: Tags a packet as part of a class or group of packets, e.g. packets sharing the same set of properties; zero when unused.
